labels.reason: The table reports concentration-specific rat serum binding of polymyxin B1 by equilibrium dialysis and ultrafiltration. Its note identifies a conflicting rat source; applicability and the conflict require later review.

evidence.quote: Rat serum protein binding of polymyxin B1
S24 | DOI 10.1128/AAC.01815-15 | Table 1 (Abodakpi et al. 2015, PMC4604353)
Pure in-vitro spiking of commercial pooled serum (Equitech-Bio); equilibrium dialysis (ED) and ultrafiltration (UF), triplicate per concentration, 37 °C 2 h.
Values are percent BOUND for polymyxin B1 only, mean ± SD. Spiked concentrations 1.25–10 µg/mL. Not ELF or tissue binding.
Conflicts with S21 (rat 80% bound, UF) and S02 (mouse about 91%). Do not average sources; treat fu as a sensitivity parameter.

findings.reason: The worksheet reports rat binding values of 92.5–98.9% bound and notes a conflicting S21 rat value of 80% bound. S21 itself is not supplied in this item, so the conflict cannot be adjudicated here.
findings.needed_material: Authorized S21 source evidence and a source-specific review of rat binding definitions, matrix, method and conditions; retain separate values for sensitivity assessment.

findings.reason: This item states the methods, pooled serum, temperature, duration and concentration range, but does not state pH or recovery, mass balance or nonspecific binding information.
findings.needed_material: Authorized source details for pH and recovery, mass balance or nonspecific binding, if reported, plus an applicability review for the intended unbound exposure.

findings.reason: The note mentions S02 mouse binding and says human columns are in a separate workbook. This rat worksheet provides no mouse or horse binding measurements.
findings.needed_material: Independent review of authorized mouse and horse binding evidence and the separately stored human columns under their applicable access rules.
